name: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest crude and gas producer (~19 Mt crude, ~20 BCM gas a year standalone, ~60% of domestic production) with overseas arm ONGC Videsh and subsidiaries HPCL (54.9%) and MRPL (71.6%). Crude is sold to Indian refiners at Brent-linked prices; gas is sold at administered (APM) and ceiling-linked prices. Government holds 58.9%. Q1 FY27 standalone profit Rs 6,554 cr; consolidated results are dragged by HPCL's Q1 under-recovery loss.

revenue_mix.geography: India (revenue consolidated, share of upstream-only revenue; model knowledge)

exposures.mechanism: Standalone crude ~19 Mt (140m bbl) at ~$95: +10% = +$9.5 x 140m = $1.33bn = Rs 12.6k cr gross, ~Rs 10k cr after royalty/cess = ~+15% of standalone EBITDA (~Rs 65k cr) x EV/MCap 1.2 x persistence 0.4 => +7.2 before HPCL drag; HPCL's Brent loss is carried by the ONGC->HINDPETRO link (not here). Shrink for windfall-tax and subsidy-sharing risk and APM caps => +3.5. Pack +2.57 (t +5.3) is in line (consolidated beta includes HPCL offset).

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 net profit Rs6,554 cr (BusinessLine 8 Aug)

exposures.mechanism: Realisations are USD benchmarked: INR 3% weaker => +3% on Rs ~1.4 lakh cr standalone revenue = Rs 4.2k cr, 6.5% of EBITDA x 1.2 x persistence 0.5 => +3.9; USD debt of OVL/HPCL consolidated offsets => +3.0. Pack +3.60 (t +2.5) agrees.

ONGC sells ~20 BCM gas; APM price is formula-linked to crude (cap/floor) and HPHT/new-gas at ceilings, so LNG moves matter only for the new-gas ceiling reset: +15% => +1% revenue => +0.5. Pack -0.67 (t -1.7) is a Henry-Hub proxy that co-moves with risk-off, low weight.
+1 = SAED reimposed at ~Rs 10,000/t. 19 Mt x Rs 10,000 = Rs 1.9k cr = 2.9% of standalone EBITDA x 1.2 x persistence 0.5 => -1.7; round to -1.5. Hit cap-ed in 2022 at Rs 23k/t when Brent >$110.

evidence.note: Upstream vs downstream PSU energy stocks (Value Research)

exposures.mechanism: Via MRPL (71.6% subsidiary, 15 MMTPA; not in universe): +$2 x 110m bbl = $220m = Rs 2.1k cr = ~3% of consolidated EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.4 x persistence 0.3 => +1.3. Pack +1.98 (t +4.2) mostly Brent proxy.
Consolidated debt ~Rs 1.2 lakh cr (HPCL-driven); floating share 40%: 25bp = Rs 120 cr, ~0.8% of PBT; yield stock 5.8% => -0.6.

+1 = Rs25k cr OMC compensation: if upstream bears ~20% (precedent: pre-2015 discounts) = Rs 5k cr pre-tax = 3.4% (Rs 3.8k cr post-tax = 1.3% of Rs 2.89 lakh cr market cap) with 0.75 probability => -1.0; offset: ONGC owns 54.9% of HPCL, which gains via the holding link.

evidence.note: OMCs seek Rs75,000 cr; Centre to decide in 2027

exposures.mechanism: Escalation => Brent +12% => +4.2 (Brent edge); ONGC Videsh assets (Azerbaijan, Mozambique Rovuma 16%, Sakhalin-1, Vankor, Venezuela) mostly outside the Gulf; negative: HPCL consolidated losses. Net +3.5, wide range.
ONGC Videsh holds 20% of Sakhalin-1, 26% of Vankor, Taas-Yuryakh (model knowledge); sanction easing unblocks ~$500m dividends (Rs 4.7k cr = 1.6% of mcap) x probability 0.5 => +0.8, +1.0 rounded.
Upstream earnings are price-driven; via HPCL's marketing volumes and gas demand: small +0.3.

company_links.mechanism: Unit: % change in ONGC equity value per +1% change in HPCL equity value. ONGC owns 54.9% of HPCL (market value ~Rs 44.6k cr = 15.4% of ONGC's Rs 2.89 lakh cr market cap); holding discount ~20% => 0.12.
